_comment: 完全虚构的工业变频器手册片段，用于离线测试。设备名、参数号、页码均为编造，与任何真实厂商文档无关。

parents.text:
1 Setup > 1.2 Selecting the Control Mode

The control mode is selected in parameter 1-00 Control Mode. Option [9] activates the positioning function, option [10] activates the synchronization function. Do not confuse this parameter with parameter 8-10 Control Word Profile, which selects the meaning of the control word bits.

1 Setup > Table 1: Control Word Bits

Bit 0: Enable the drive.
Bit 1: Start the motor.
Bit 2: Reverse direction.
Bit 3: Reset an alarm.

2 Diagnostics > 2.1 Alarm Handling

Alarm A13 indicates an overcurrent fault. Reset the drive by pressing the reset key on the local control panel, or by writing 1 to bit 3 of the control word. If the alarm returns within one minute, the fault is still present.

3 Limits > 3.1 Ambient Conditions

The operating temperature range is -10 to +50 degrees Celsius. Derate the drive above 40 degrees Celsius. The storage temperature range is -25 to +65 degrees Celsius.
